name: pixelbolt-pixel-art
description: Pixel-art game effects and sprites with Pixelbolt JSON recipes - fire, explosions, splashes, smoke, water, magic spells and sparks, simulated and baked into palette pixels, plus sprites, sprite sheets, tiles, icons and short animations - saved as PNG, GIF, APNG, atlases or video frames. Use when someone asks for a pixel-art effect, VFX sheet or sprite, or to draw, animate, repair or export pixel art, before writing a drawing script by hand. Not for vector or SVG output, photo editing or pictures from an image model, though it can redraw a logo or icon as pixel art. Local, no account, no API key.
